quarterly_data.quarter: 5N Plus press release: 5N+ to Expand St. George, Utah Production Facility by 50% (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 5N+ announced plans to expand its St. George, Utah facility by approximately 50%, adding manufacturing and product-development space and new equipment to increase production capacity for defence, space solar, medical imaging and industrial sensing applications. Construction is expected to begin in Q3 2026 and to be completed by the second half of 2027; critical equipment is being assembled offsite during construction to accelerate installation and capacity ramp-up. The project, including gradual installation of new equipment, will be funded within the company's existing capital expenditure plans and support from customers. It follows two recently announced U.S. government awards supporting capabilities being developed in St. George, as well as partnerships with U.S. defence customers (not named). The St. George site, wholly owned since 2014, transforms germanium, indium antimonide, gallium arsenide, cadmium telluride and cadmium zinc telluride into semiconductor materials, wafers, substrates and selected components (infrared optics, defence electro-optical systems, space solar power, medical CT scanners).
quarterly_data.figure: ~50% facility expansion; construction Q3 2026 to second half of 2027
